notes: This44x44 envelope is explicitly unverified in the game.
Generic placement preferences and one-tile defense spacing are design proposals, not troop-chain rules.
All unpinned instances are repacked; this is not a matched wall-only intervention.
The inherited modes, hero assignments and CC choice remain proposed settings.
No defense performance score or optimum is claimed.
design_configuration.objective: Test Town Hall denial and actual defender trophies against ordinary and competent air/Thrower plans

provenance.design: Synthetic per-TH camp/Lab/Castle caps; explicit benchmark equipment; not a player or current meta distribution

planning_evidence.recipient_level_basis: Unique snapshot match of entered troop/spell/siege storage capacities 55/3/2 at TH17

assumptions: Full catalog-capped TH17 Dragon army and Castle housing; same fixed attack across both TH16 layouts
Spell coordinates reflect with entry; ability schedule is fixed or +5 seconds
Padded open board and static initial deployment mask are hypotheses
Held-out entry/policy cases are synthetic robustness checks, not replay calibration
Original user V3 and screenshot are not generator inputs
Behavior contracts were explicitly adopted from component fixtures; passing a fixture does not establish real game behavior.
Equipment levels are owned; selected pairs are benchmark candidates, not the player's confirmed current loadout.
Troop, hero and pet levels use the separately saved potion planning account; recipient donation caps remain snapshot hypotheses.
Deployment margin, schedules, target scoring, instantaneous ordinary projectiles and siege geometry are uncalibrated.
Grand Warden uses independent targeting; army-following behavior is not implemented.
Mirror clones initially overlap the owner under the explicit point-unit model.
Ice Golem on-hit slow of 0.25 attack rate for two seconds is an unverified hypothesis.
Eagle activation uses explicit weights: troop housing, heroes 25, siege 1, pets and clones 0; spell housing times five; hero abilities 0.
Rage uses troop 1 and hero/pet 0.5 scaling; these class factors require calibration.
Explicit opt-in to declared_air_weapon_follows_departing_retained_target_at_target_speed; uncalibrated and outcome-changing
Hot Candle phase4/module-level1 is a conditional pinned selection, not current-season certification
